description: Control flights of the tick-grid step (MIGRATION_V2 step 3.1; lead decision in docs/requests/sim-core-v2-1.md): the UNMODIFIED v1 simulation (src/sim/world/sim.ts of commit 6f012fe, every other file as of the tick-grid commit) flying lunar-direct with nothing changed but the scenario start, moved by +2.004 ms (the tick-aligned start), +8.333 ms, -5 ms and +16.667 ms. They measure how far the same code moves when only time moves; tools/dev/mission-baseline.ts compares a flight with tests/mission/baseline-v1.json inside twice their spread (ENVELOPE). Recorded once, on 2026-11-12, while the v1 clock could still be run; the v1 code is not in the tree, so this file cannot be recorded again and is never rewritten.

controls.label: v1 clock, start +2.004 ms (the tick-aligned start)

compare.exact: EXACT, for a step that must not change behaviour and starts at the bit-identical instant: every milestone has the same id, event time (ut), capture time, body, situation, state (r, v, mass), readouts and data, compared for equality. The first milestone that differs is where the change begins.
compare.envelope: ENVELOPE, for a step that legitimately moves time (the tick grid, the session switch): per milestone, |event mission time - reference| and |a - a_ref| / |a_ref| must each be within twice the largest such difference among the control flights (the reference code with shifted starts only; recorded by the owner of the step in a controls file), with floors of one control tick (1/30 s) and 1e-12. The mission gates must pass as well.
notes: The scripted pilot decides at 30 Hz, so a flight is a chaotic function of its start instant: a 2 ms shift of the unmodified v1 code moves EARTH_ORBIT by 4.8e-5 in da/a and the lunar touchdown by 47 s. A fixed tolerance cannot tell a moved clock from a changed simulation; the control flights can.
Angles are compared as wrapped absolute differences. The true anomaly (nu) is never compared.

captureOffset is the time after the event at which the state was taken (the first control tick that sees the milestone): 0 for events that coincide with a control tick, up to 1/30 s otherwise. Under thrust or drag the state at the capture is not the state at the event.
Event mission time is ut - startUt of the same record.
